breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the contradictory half-shift instruction. It states 'gamma-centered automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift' and specifies 'K_POINTS automatic with grid 4 4 4 1 1 1', which is a half-shifted grid, not a gamma-centered grid (which would use 0 0 0 offsets). The ground truth removes the half-shift entirely, keeping only the gamma-centered grid directive. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead implemented the erroneous half-shift.
